table.name: Start Injection Angle (Stop-Start Restart, Low Rail Pressure)
table.description:
Injection angle while cranking for a stop-start restart with rail pressure below 2 MPa. Stop-start cannot activate in this calibration, so probably unused. Not clamped by the ECU: keep it within 0.5-180 BTDC. Edit with the High Rail Pressure table.
Details: When used: while cranking (fuel state FFF8906B = 2) with the stop-start restart request FFF89066 bit 0 set and rail pressure FFF88884 below cal 0x2A65E (3279 = 2.0 MPa / 290 psi) (0x0CFB28, called from 0x0C589C with (906B, coolant FFF88A44, rpm/50, cal 0x38448 bit 7, FFF89066 bit 0, FFF88884, &FFF8B050, &FFF8B008), args read in the caller's disassembly). Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (720 - code/2; larger = earlier), same scale as every injection-angle table (my research notes). It replaces Start Injection Angle (Fuel Mode 0) in FFF8B050, which 0x0CB394 uses as the first-pulse angle of injectors in fuel mode 0 (segment 3, offset B050 - 1080) (read). Unlike that table it is only floored at code 0, not clamped to 1080-1439, so keep it within 180-0.5 BTDC (code 1080-1439) (read). Setting cal 0x38448 bit 7 would force cal 0x11EBC (clamped to 1080-1439) instead. FFF89066 bit 0 = CAN 0x15A byte 2 bit 0, the restart request of the engine stop-start feature (signals_rates_can.md, my research notes, read). Edit with the High Rail Pressure table. LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7D501B: same code as LG7F301F; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Injection Angle (Stop-Start Restart, High Rail Pressure)
table.description:
Injection angle while cranking for a stop-start restart with rail pressure at or above 2 MPa. Probably unused (stop-start cannot activate). Not clamped: keep within 0.5-180 BTDC.
Details: When used: as Start Injection Angle (Stop-Start Restart, Low Rail Pressure), but with rail pressure FFF88884 at or above cal 0x2A65E (3279 = 2.0 MPa / 290 psi) (0x0CFB28, read). Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (720 - code/2; larger = earlier), same scale as every injection-angle table (my research notes). Only floored at code 0, not clamped (read): keep it within 180-0.5 BTDC (code 1080-1439). FFF89066 bit 0 = CAN 0x15A byte 2 bit 0, the restart request of the engine stop-start feature (signals_rates_can.md, my research notes, read). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7D501B: same code as LG7F301F; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Injection Timing (Stop-Start Restart)
table.description:
Replaces Cranking Injection Timing while cranking for a stop-start restart. Stop-start cannot activate in this calibration, so probably unused.
Details: When used: while cranking (FFF8906B = 2) with the stop-start restart request FFF89066 bit 0 set; then it replaces Cranking Injection Timing as the main injection angle FFF8B052 (0x0CFE8C, read; args read in 0x0C589C: param_5 = coolant FFF88A44, param_11 = FFF89066 bit 0). Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (720 - code/2; larger = earlier), same scale as every injection-angle table (my research notes). Clamped to code 360-1079 = 180.5-540 BTDC (read). Cal 0x38448 bit 6 would force cal 0x11FE6. FFF89066 bit 0 = CAN 0x15A byte 2 bit 0, the restart request of the engine stop-start feature (signals_rates_can.md, my research notes, read). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (similarity port (code)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7D501B: same code as LG7F301F; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Double Injection Split
table.description:
Share of the fuel in the first of two injections; the second gets the rest.
Details: Share of the fuel in the first of two injections (0x0D05D8 -> FFF8B068 -> FFF8A6D1, read); the second gets the rest (0x0D0D50). Limited by FFF8A6DA (read). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7D501B: same code as LG7F301F; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Triple Injection Split 1
table.description:
Share of the fuel in the first of three injections (the third gets what the first two leave).
Details: Share of the fuel in the first of three injections (0x0D06EC -> FFF8A6C9 -> FFF8A6D3, read); the third gets 128 minus the first two (0x0D0DC0). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7D501B: same code as LG7F301F; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Triple Injection Split 2
table.description:
Share of the fuel in the second of three injections.
Details: Share of the fuel in the second of three injections (0x0D06EC -> FFF8A6CA -> FFF8A6D4, read). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7D501B: same code as LG7F301F; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

Volumetric Efficiency (AVCS Not Ready)
table.description:
VE table that would replace the normal TGV-blended VE while the cams are probably not yet ready.
When that bit is set, 0x11E308 uses this table instead of the Volumetric Efficiency (TGV Closed) / (TGV Open) blend while FFF8A83B bit 7 is clear (read). That bit is an AVCS-ready flag from 0x1050F4 that needs both cam references learned (inferred meaning). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7D501B: same code as LG7F301F; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Throttle Flow Coefficient (Reverse Flow)
table.description:
Coefficient of the throttle airflow model when the manifold is above the pre-throttle pressure. Leave alone.
Details: When used: every model pass while r > 1.0 (manifold above the pre-throttle pressure; the ratio is inverted). 0x11DD04 (read), enabled by FFF8A8FB bit 0 (0x11E43C): modelled throttle flow FFF8C24C [g/min] = (P_up/101325) x Throttle Flow Function(r) x FFF8ADEC (Throttle Area from Throttle Position, 0.05 mm^2) x Throttle Flow Temperature Correction x this x 60000 x 2.98e-15, which feeds the manifold/airflow observer 0x11DB50 / 0x11D938. Normally leave alone. LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (between exact neighbours (228 bytes below, 49 above, both moved by the same amount; inferred)). LG7D501B: same code as LG7F301F; address from the same instruction (between exact neighbours (228 bytes below, 49 above, both moved by the same amount; inferred)). Confidence: inferred.

Intake OCV Base Duty (Cam 1, Legacy Path)
table.description:
Base intake cam 1 valve duty by rpm for an older, byte-based cam control path.
Base term by rpm of the intake cam 1 OCV duty in the legacy byte-based AVCS path: about 49.2-52.0 % duty before the FFF88AA4 factor; the learned and feedback bytes are added around 128 (= 51.2 %). Module (read): seg 0x100000 0x104xxx-0x106xxx is the byte-based cam path; 0x10466C (intake, called at seg_0x100000.c:3516 with rpm CD54, FFF88AA4, learned bytes FFF8147A/147C/147E, feedback bytes FFF8B368, cam errors B956/B954) forms per cam: B352 = this(rpm) x 026EB0/026EC0(FFF88AA4)/128; B356 = 147A if the cam error >= cal 0x26E82 (364 = 2.0 deg), 147C if <= cal 0x26E84 (-2.0 deg), else 128; B366 = clamp(B368 + B352 + 147E + B356 - 384, 0, 250). 0x106A0C does the same for the exhaust cams (05CF08/05CF14, factors 0298F4/029904, errors B916/B914, thresholds cal 0x298C6/0x298C8) into B380. The OCV duty routines 0x15DF20 / 0x15E63C (intake cam 1 / 2) and 0x16269C / 0x162D18 (exhaust) set duty B8DE = B366[cam] x 10 (B380 for exhaust) only when cal 0x3CCC4 bit 0 is clear (read). FFF88AA4 = (FFF88AE6 >> 8 - 10) x 1.6 (0x060000 area, read); FFF88AE6 not identified. LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7D501B: same code as LG7F301F; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

EGR Target Rate (TGV Open, Multi-Injection)
table.description:
EGR rate target by rpm and load with the TGVs open and multiple injections per cycle.
Details: When used: TGVs not closed and multi-injection active (FFF8A775 bit 1); cal 0x2F797 bit 5 clear. Base target EGR rate A818, looked up by 0x0FA10C with rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616 (read, disassembly). Target EGR rate (0x0FA260, read): FFF8A81A = base A817 x Coolant Multiplier 05CB04/255 x 255/255 (A816) x Reduction Multiplier A81C/255 x DAM Multiplier 05CB10/128, x 640 (1/640 units), capped at cal 0x2C4E6 (192 = 30 %) and forced to 0 unless the enable conditions FFF8A811 bit 0 hold (0x0FAAFC). A817 follows the base table A818 (0x0FA068). Multi-injection = FFF8A775 bit 1, set by 0x0FAABC when the multi-injection enable FFF8A775 bit 0 is set and all four per-injector strategy bytes FFF8A69F..A6A2 are 2 or 3 (read). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). 0 = no EGR. LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

Target EGR rate (0x0FA260, read): FFF8A81A = base A817 x Coolant Multiplier 05CB04/255 x 255/255 (A816) x Reduction Multiplier A81C/255 x DAM Multiplier 05CB10/128, x 640 (1/640 units), capped at cal 0x2C4E6 (192 = 30 %) and forced to 0 unless the enable conditions FFF8A811 bit 0 hold (0x0FAAFC). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

Target EGR rate (0x0FA260, read): FFF8A81A = base A817 x Coolant Multiplier 05CB04/255 x 255/255 (A816) x Reduction Multiplier A81C/255 x DAM Multiplier 05CB10/128, x 640 (1/640 units), capped at cal 0x2C4E6 (192 = 30 %) and forced to 0 unless the enable conditions FFF8A811 bit 0 hold (0x0FAAFC). A817 follows the base table A818 (0x0FA068). Multi-injection = FFF8A775 bit 1, set by 0x0FAABC when the multi-injection enable FFF8A775 bit 0 is set and all four per-injector strategy bytes FFF8A69F..A6A2 are 2 or 3 (read). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). p16 (read): second axis FFF8CD77 = (ETC throttle position FFF8A342 - 10)/4 = (ETC actual position FFF8A2B6 - 1000)/256 (0x09D58E, 0x09DAAE, 0x0A0680, 0x06AB94): a throttle-position byte, about 0.56 % per count (inferred). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

Alternator Command from Target Voltage
table.description: Alternator control duty by target charging voltage (probably). Changing it changes the charging voltage the alternator actually reaches. Also feeds Idle Air Trim (Charging Command).

table.name: Charging Target Temperature Correction
table.description: Subtracted from the charging target (when that target is at or above the threshold): negative values raise the target. The axis is a raw value from the battery sensor, probably its temperature.

table.name: Charge Control Delay After Start (SOC, Battery Sensor)
table.description: After a start, charge control (the battery-charged decision and adaptive charging) may begin this long after the engine starts, by the estimated state of charge at start and the battery sensor value.

table.name: Charge Control Charge After Start (SOC)
table.description: Charge control may also begin once the battery has taken back this much charge since the start, by the estimated state of charge at start.

table.name: Battery State of Charge Reset Value
Radiator Fan Duty (Coolant, Flag A807 Set)
Adaptive Charging Target Current
table.description: During adaptive charging the ECU steers the charging voltage so the battery takes this current, by state of charge: positive charges, negative lets the battery discharge.

table.name: Adaptive Charging Current Gain
table.description: How strongly adaptive charging moves its voltage target to reach the target battery current.

table.name: Radiator Fan Duty (Coolant, CAN 0x282 Value High)
Charging Feedback Proportional
table.description: Correction added to the charging target in proportion to how far the battery voltage is from it.

table.name: Charging Feedback Integral Step Up
table.description: How fast the charging-voltage feedback raises the target when the battery is below it.

table.name: Charging Feedback Integral Step Down
table.description: How fast the charging-voltage feedback lowers the target when the battery is above it.

table.name: Charging Feedback Integral Gain
table.description:
Scales the feedback integral (100 = as is).
Details: Integral x this / 100 after the clamp (0x13866C, read). Address 0432F4. Confidence: read.

table.name: Charging Feedback Deadband Above
table.description: Battery voltage may be this far above target before the integral steps down.

table.name: Charging Feedback Deadband Below
table.description: Battery voltage may be this far below target before the integral steps up.

table.name: Charging Feedback Minimum RPM
table.description: The charging-voltage feedback only runs above this engine speed.

table.name: Start Injection Angle (Stop-Start Restart, Low Rail Pressure)
table.description:
Injection angle while cranking for a stop-start restart with rail pressure below 2 MPa. Stop-start cannot activate in this calibration, so probably unused. Not clamped by the ECU: keep it within 0.5-180 BTDC. Edit with the High Rail Pressure table.
Details: When used: while cranking (fuel state FFF8906B = 2) with the stop-start restart request FFF89066 bit 0 set and rail pressure FFF88884 below cal 0x2A65E (3279 = 2.0 MPa / 290 psi) (0x0CFB28, called from 0x0C589C with (906B, coolant FFF88A44, rpm/50, cal 0x38448 bit 7, FFF89066 bit 0, FFF88884, &FFF8B050, &FFF8B008), args read in the caller's disassembly). Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (720 - code/2; larger = earlier), same scale as every injection-angle table (my research notes). It replaces Start Injection Angle (Fuel Mode 0) in FFF8B050, which 0x0CB394 uses as the first-pulse angle of injectors in fuel mode 0 (segment 3, offset B050 - 1080) (read). Unlike that table it is only floored at code 0, not clamped to 1080-1439, so keep it within 180-0.5 BTDC (code 1080-1439) (read). Setting cal 0x38448 bit 7 would force cal 0x11EBC (clamped to 1080-1439) instead. FFF89066 bit 0 = CAN 0x15A byte 2 bit 0, the restart request of the engine stop-start feature (signals_rates_can.md, my research notes, read). Edit with the High Rail Pressure table. LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Injection Angle (Stop-Start Restart, High Rail Pressure)
table.description:
Injection angle while cranking for a stop-start restart with rail pressure at or above 2 MPa. Probably unused (stop-start cannot activate). Not clamped: keep within 0.5-180 BTDC.
Details: When used: as Start Injection Angle (Stop-Start Restart, Low Rail Pressure), but with rail pressure FFF88884 at or above cal 0x2A65E (3279 = 2.0 MPa / 290 psi) (0x0CFB28, read). Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (720 - code/2; larger = earlier), same scale as every injection-angle table (my research notes). Only floored at code 0, not clamped (read): keep it within 180-0.5 BTDC (code 1080-1439). FFF89066 bit 0 = CAN 0x15A byte 2 bit 0, the restart request of the engine stop-start feature (signals_rates_can.md, my research notes, read). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Injection Timing (Stop-Start Restart)
table.description:
Replaces Cranking Injection Timing while cranking for a stop-start restart. Stop-start cannot activate in this calibration, so probably unused.
Details: When used: while cranking (FFF8906B = 2) with the stop-start restart request FFF89066 bit 0 set; then it replaces Cranking Injection Timing as the main injection angle FFF8B052 (0x0CFE8C, read; args read in 0x0C589C: param_5 = coolant FFF88A44, param_11 = FFF89066 bit 0). Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (720 - code/2; larger = earlier), same scale as every injection-angle table (my research notes). Clamped to code 360-1079 = 180.5-540 BTDC (read). Cal 0x38448 bit 6 would force cal 0x11FE6. FFF89066 bit 0 = CAN 0x15A byte 2 bit 0, the restart request of the engine stop-start feature (signals_rates_can.md, my research notes, read). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (similarity port (code)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Double Injection Split
table.description:
Share of the fuel in the first of two injections; the second gets the rest.
Details: Share of the fuel in the first of two injections (0x0D05D8 -> FFF8B068 -> FFF8A6D1, read); the second gets the rest (0x0D0D50). Limited by FFF8A6DA (read). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Triple Injection Split 1
table.description:
Share of the fuel in the first of three injections (the third gets what the first two leave).
Details: Share of the fuel in the first of three injections (0x0D06EC -> FFF8A6C9 -> FFF8A6D3, read); the third gets 128 minus the first two (0x0D0DC0). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Triple Injection Split 2
table.description:
Share of the fuel in the second of three injections.
Details: Share of the fuel in the second of three injections (0x0D06EC -> FFF8A6CA -> FFF8A6D4, read). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

Volumetric Efficiency (AVCS Not Ready)
table.description:
VE table that would replace the normal TGV-blended VE while the cams are probably not yet ready.
When that bit is set, 0x11E308 uses this table instead of the Volumetric Efficiency (TGV Closed) / (TGV Open) blend while FFF8A83B bit 7 is clear (read). That bit is an AVCS-ready flag from 0x1050F4 that needs both cam references learned (inferred meaning). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Throttle Flow Coefficient (Reverse Flow)
table.description:
Coefficient of the throttle airflow model when the manifold is above the pre-throttle pressure. Leave alone.
Details: When used: every model pass while r > 1.0 (manifold above the pre-throttle pressure; the ratio is inverted). 0x11DD04 (read), enabled by FFF8A8FB bit 0 (0x11E43C): modelled throttle flow FFF8C24C [g/min] = (P_up/101325) x Throttle Flow Function(r) x FFF8ADEC (Throttle Area from Throttle Position, 0.05 mm^2) x Throttle Flow Temperature Correction x this x 60000 x 2.98e-15, which feeds the manifold/airflow observer 0x11DB50 / 0x11D938. Normally leave alone. LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (between exact neighbours (228 bytes below, 49 above, both moved by the same amount; inferred)). Confidence: inferred.

Intake OCV Base Duty (Cam 1, Legacy Path)
table.description:
Base intake cam 1 valve duty by rpm for an older, byte-based cam control path.
Base term by rpm of the intake cam 1 OCV duty in the legacy byte-based AVCS path: about 49.2-52.0 % duty before the FFF88AA4 factor; the learned and feedback bytes are added around 128 (= 51.2 %). Module (read): seg 0x100000 0x104xxx-0x106xxx is the byte-based cam path; 0x10466C (intake, called at seg_0x100000.c:3516 with rpm CD54, FFF88AA4, learned bytes FFF8147A/147C/147E, feedback bytes FFF8B368, cam errors B956/B954) forms per cam: B352 = this(rpm) x 026EB0/026EC0(FFF88AA4)/128; B356 = 147A if the cam error >= cal 0x26E82 (364 = 2.0 deg), 147C if <= cal 0x26E84 (-2.0 deg), else 128; B366 = clamp(B368 + B352 + 147E + B356 - 384, 0, 250). 0x106A0C does the same for the exhaust cams (05CF08/05CF14, factors 0298F4/029904, errors B916/B914, thresholds cal 0x298C6/0x298C8) into B380. The OCV duty routines 0x15DF20 / 0x15E63C (intake cam 1 / 2) and 0x16269C / 0x162D18 (exhaust) set duty B8DE = B366[cam] x 10 (B380 for exhaust) only when cal 0x3CCC4 bit 0 is clear (read). FFF88AA4 = (FFF88AE6 >> 8 - 10) x 1.6 (0x060000 area, read); FFF88AE6 not identified. LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

EGR Target Rate (TGV Open, Multi-Injection)
table.description:
EGR rate target by rpm and load with the TGVs open and multiple injections per cycle.
Details: When used: TGVs not closed and multi-injection active (FFF8A775 bit 1); cal 0x2F797 bit 5 clear. Base target EGR rate A818, looked up by 0x0FA10C with rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616 (read, disassembly). Target EGR rate (0x0FA260, read): FFF8A81A = base A817 x Coolant Multiplier 05CB04/255 x 255/255 (A816) x Reduction Multiplier A81C/255 x DAM Multiplier 05CB10/128, x 640 (1/640 units), capped at cal 0x2C4E6 (192 = 30 %) and forced to 0 unless the enable conditions FFF8A811 bit 0 hold (0x0FAAFC). A817 follows the base table A818 (0x0FA068). Multi-injection = FFF8A775 bit 1, set by 0x0FAABC when the multi-injection enable FFF8A775 bit 0 is set and all four per-injector strategy bytes FFF8A69F..A6A2 are 2 or 3 (read). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). 0 = no EGR. LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate (Alternate, TGV Open)
table.description:
Alternate EGR rate target by rpm and throttle position (instead of load) with the TGVs open.
Details: When used: only when cal 0x2F797 bit 5 is set. Alternate base target EGR rate A818 (0x0FA10C, read), indexed by rpm FFF8CD54 and throttle position FFF8CD77 (about 0.56 % per count, see below) instead of load. Target EGR rate (0x0FA260, read): FFF8A81A = base A817 x Coolant Multiplier 05CB04/255 x 255/255 (A816) x Reduction Multiplier A81C/255 x DAM Multiplier 05CB10/128, x 640 (1/640 units), capped at cal 0x2C4E6 (192 = 30 %) and forced to 0 unless the enable conditions FFF8A811 bit 0 hold (0x0FAAFC). A817 follows the base table A818 (0x0FA068). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). p16 (read): second axis FFF8CD77 = (ETC throttle position FFF8A342 - 10)/4 = (ETC actual position FFF8A2B6 - 1000)/256 (0x09D58E, 0x09DAAE, 0x0A0680, 0x06AB94): a throttle-position byte, about 0.56 % per count (inferred). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LG7F301F: same code as LT8H300D; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Confidence: inferred.
